reason: Primary user-facing purpose is a memory and persona enhancement plugin for DeepSeek Harness, with evidence showing layered local memory management, response-context injection, and UI/API controls for persona and mood/state management; this aligns most directly with memory-context over other plugin/tool categories.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 的记忆与人格插件，支持在三层记忆中持久化管理会话信息，并通过界面与 API 管理人格约束和心情状态。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness memory and persona plugin that lets users manage persistent layered memory and MOOD/persona settings through web UI and API controls.

capabilities: Persistent local storage of user/session memory across sessions
Conversation memory tools exposed with a consistent lan_ prefix
Persona and MOOD settings that influence generated responses
GUI plus API management for memory/persona operations
Local dedup/merge maintenance workflow with backup before write

reasons.code: README describes a three-layer memory model (pinned.md, memory.jsonl, experience.jsonl) with system injection for persistent conversational context.
README lists lan_ tools such as lan_pin/lan_remember/lan_recall/lan_dream and REST routes for managing memory and personality.
README states data is stored under ~/.dsh/hanako (override via DSH_LAN_DATA_DIR) and one-click maintenance performs backup + dedup/merge before writing.
package.json declares dsh.bundle patch and web client integration entrypoints, confirming it is a DeepSeek Harness plugin with web UI components.
